settings.question: Are Alchemia MD products dermatologist-formulated?
settings.answer: Alchemia MD was founded by board-certified dermatologist Dr. Mia Luna, and our supplements are dermatologist-formulated.

settings.question: Who is Alchemia MD for?
settings.answer: Alchemia MD is designed for people who want daily internal skin health support, especially those with active, sun-exposed lifestyles such as golf, tennis, boating, beach days and travel.†

settings.question: What does each formula do?
settings.answer: UV Shield+ is the Protect step, with daily antioxidant and nutritional support for skin exposed to life outdoors.† Skinbiotic+ is the Balance step, a synbiotic designed around the gut-skin connection. Dermaboost+ is the Restore step, with immune-supportive and antioxidant nutrition for calm, balanced skin.†

settings.question: Where can I see the full ingredient list?
settings.answer: Every product page shows the full Supplement Facts, and the Science page lists each ingredient and amount as printed on the label.

settings.question: How long does one bottle last?
settings.answer: UV Shield+ contains 60 capsules, which last 30 days at the daily serving and 15 days when taken twice a day. Dermaboost+ contains 60 capsules, a 30-day supply at the daily serving. Skinbiotic+ contains 30 capsules, a 30-day supply at one capsule daily.

settings.question: What is the difference between an individual product and a bundle?
settings.answer: An individual product is a single formula. A bundle combines complementary formulas into one daily routine, so you can start with what you need and add to it over time.

settings.question: Can I start with just one product?
settings.answer: Yes. Each formula has its own role and you can start with one. The bundles are for people who want a combined routine, and Tria Prima is the most comprehensive option.

settings.question: Can I take more than one product together?
settings.answer: Yes. The products are designed to work together as a daily routine. Follow the suggested use on each product label.

settings.question: How do Alchemia MD products fit with sunscreen?
settings.answer: They don't. Alchemia MD supplements are not sunscreen and do not replace sun protection. Keep using broad-spectrum sunscreen, protective clothing and shade.

settings.question: How do I take UV Shield+ and Dermaboost+?
settings.answer: UV Shield+: Take two (2) capsules once daily with water. For enhanced support, take two (2) capsules twice daily with water. Dermaboost+: Take two (2) capsules once daily with water.

settings.question: Should I check with my healthcare professional first?
settings.answer: Consult your healthcare professional before taking if you are pregnant, nursing, taking any medications or have a medical condition.

settings.question: How do I manage my subscription?
settings.answer: Use the Manage subscription link in the site header or footer.

settings.question: How can I contact Alchemia MD?
settings.answer: Email info@dermalchemistmd.com or use the form on the Contact page.

settings.question: How much does shipping cost?
settings.answer: In the United States, standard shipping is $8.00 on orders under $70 and free on orders of $70 or more. Express shipping is $15.00. International rates are calculated at checkout. See our Shipping policy for delivery times and the countries we ship to.

settings.question: Do you ship internationally?
settings.answer: Yes. We ship to the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, much of Europe, Australia, New Zealand, Japan, South Korea, Singapore, Hong Kong, Malaysia, Israel and the United Arab Emirates. Import duties and taxes may apply and are the recipient’s responsibility. See the Shipping policy.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: Unopened, unused products can be returned within 30 days of delivery. If an item arrives damaged, defective or incorrect, email us within 14 days and we will replace it or refund you. See the full Refund policy.
